_attribution: Course timings and capabilities researched from public Zojirushi BB-PDC20 documentation and community sources. Machine-specification facts are not copyrightable; this notice is a courtesy.
_methodology: Each entry's 'confidence' field reflects source authority: 'verified' = Zojirushi-published spec; 'inferred' = derived from the manual's recipe instructions (e.g., add-ins beep timing); 'community' = Fresh Loaf / Reddit / bread-machine forum reports triangulated across at least two independent sources. The 'sources' array on each entry lists URLs (manual references where available; community thread URLs otherwise). Stage-level temperature targets are typically not published; entries that include 'target_temp_c' are inferred from heated-element duty cycles in community oscilloscope traces and are flagged as 'community' or 'inferred' confidence accordingly. Single-source community claims do not populate typed inferred-bucket fields (hydration_range, whole_wheat_max_pct); they land as a free-form sentence in the row's 'notes' field with the source URL inlined parenthetically.

entries.name: White

stages.name: preheat
stages.notes: Manual's REST cycle: stabilizes ingredient temperature before kneading (manual page 19). Toggleable via REST OFF; skipping it drops the total cycle to 2:54 (manual page 13).

stages.name: knead_1
stages.notes: Manual shows a single Knead phase; no documented autolyse rest between knead halves. Duration derived from Add Beep timing (45 min from start) minus REST length (31 min).

stages.name: add_ins_beep
stages.notes: Manual's Add Beep fires at approximately 45 min from start, at the end of Knead and immediately before Rise begins (manual page 13). Beep sounds for 30 seconds; modeled here as a zero-duration event marker.

stages.name: rise_1
stages.notes: Manual chart shows two unpublished Punch Down events within the Rise band; sub-stage durations are not published. Modeled as a single rise_1 stage; duration = total_minutes - preheat - knead_1 - bake.

stages.name: bake
stages.notes: Bake duration estimated from chart visual proportions (manual page 13) and the residual after Rest, Knead, and Rise are accounted for. The manual does not publish bake duration explicitly.

entries.recommended_for_notes: Default cycle for plain or lightly enriched white-flour loaves; the workhorse course of the BB-PDC20.
entries.notes: Manual page 13 cycle chart: total 3:25 MEDIUM (also 3:15 LIGHT / 3:35 DARK per recipe-book page 6 crust-time table), REST OFF: 2:54, Add Beep at approx. 45 min, separate 1-hour keep-warm hold (not included in total_minutes; model treats keep_warm as the post-cycle hold the user can cancel via the manual's page-16 step 8). Manual page 14 basic white recipe: 553g bread flour, 320g water, 6g rapid rise yeast — 57.9% hydration. Crust Control supports LIGHT/MEDIUM/DARK (manual page 18). Timer supported (manual page 17). Rest Off supported (manual page 12).

entries.name: Whole Wheat

stages.name: preheat
stages.notes: REST cycle stabilizes ingredient temperature; same 31-minute REST length as Course 1 (computed from REST OFF delta: 3:20 - 2:49).

stages.name: knead_1
stages.notes: Duration estimated from Add Beep timing midpoint (53 min, manual range 48-58 min) minus REST length (31 min).

stages.name: add_ins_beep
stages.notes: Manual page 13: 'Approx. 48-58 min' from start — published as a range, not a single value (the only course on the BB-PDC20 with a ranged Add Beep timing).

stages.name: rise_1
stages.notes: Manual chart shows two unpublished Punch Down events within Rise band; sub-stage durations not published. Modeled as a single rise_1 stage.

stages.name: bake
stages.notes: Bake duration estimated from residual after Rest, Knead, and Rise are accounted for; manual does not publish bake duration explicitly.

entries.recommended_for_notes: Optimized for whole-wheat or mixed-grain loaves with longer rises. Recipe book (page 8) shows 100% Whole Wheat, Whole Wheat Walnut, Light Rye, and Pumpernickel variants — hydration ranges 60-80%.
entries.notes: Manual page 13 cycle chart: total 3:20 (REST OFF: 2:49), Add Beep at approx. 48-58 min RANGE (the only ranged Add Beep on the catalog), separate 1-hour keep-warm hold. Crust Control NOT available (page 18) — single MEDIUM crust shade. Timer supported (page 17). Recipe PDF (page 8): 100% Whole Wheat 553g WW + 370g water = 67% hydration; 100% WW Walnut 563g WW + 450g water = 80% hydration; Light Rye mixed flour 60% hydration; Pumpernickel mixed flour 77% hydration.

entries.name: European

stages.name: preheat
stages.notes: REST OFF NOT supported on this course (manual page 12); REST length not directly measurable. Estimated from chart visual proportions (slightly shorter than Courses 1/2's 31 min).

stages.name: knead_1
stages.notes: Duration: Add Beep timing (43 min) - estimated REST length (27 min) = 16 min.

stages.name: add_ins_beep
stages.notes: Manual: Add Beep at approximately 43 min from start (page 13).

stages.name: rise_1
stages.notes: Manual chart shows two unpublished Punch Down events within Rise band.

stages.name: bake
stages.notes: Bake duration estimated from chart proportions; European has a longer bake than Course 1 White, producing a denser/darker crust at the fixed MEDIUM setting.

entries.recommended_for_notes: Rustic European-style white-flour loaves. Recipe book (page 9) covers French, Rustic Herb, Sesame, and Bacon Bread — all white-flour-based with 58-65% hydration. Manual flags this course as temperature-sensitive: results may suffer when room temperature exceeds 77°F (use chilled water).
entries.notes: Manual page 13 cycle chart: total 3:15, Add Beep at approx. 43 min, separate 1-hour keep-warm hold. REST OFF NOT supported (page 12); Crust Control NOT available (page 18) — single MEDIUM crust shade; Timer IS supported (page 17). Recipe PDF (page 9): French/Rustic/Sesame breads use 320g water + 553g bread flour = 58% hydration; Bacon Bread uses 360g water = 65%. Manual note: room temperature above 77°F may produce unsatisfactory results — use water chilled to 41°F.

entries.name: Multigrain

stages.name: preheat
stages.notes: REST OFF NOT supported on this course (manual page 12); REST length assumed equal to Courses 1/2 (31 min) since cycle structure mirrors Course 1 Basic White.

stages.name: knead_1
stages.notes: Duration: Add Beep timing (45 min) - assumed REST length (31 min) = 14 min.

stages.name: add_ins_beep
stages.notes: Manual: Add Beep at approximately 45 min from start (page 13). Recipe book Multigrain Raisin Bread (page 10) has the user add raisins at this beep.

stages.name: rise_1
stages.notes: Manual chart shows two unpublished Punch Down events within Rise band; structure mirrors Course 1 Basic White.

stages.name: bake
stages.notes: Bake duration estimated from chart visual proportions; identical to Course 1 White at MEDIUM crust.

entries.recommended_for_notes: Recipe book (page 10) shows 7 Grain, 12 Grain, and Multigrain Raisin breads using mixed flours — whole wheat + bread + grain cereals + seeds. Hydration 57-68% across recipes.
entries.notes: Manual page 13 cycle chart: total 3:15 LIGHT / 3:25 MEDIUM / 3:35 DARK, Add Beep at approx. 45 min, separate 1-hour keep-warm hold. REST OFF NOT supported (page 12); Crust Control IS supported (page 18); Timer supported (page 17). Recipe PDF (page 10): 7 Grain Bread 310g water + 545g grain mix = 57% hydration; 12 Grain ~330g water; Multigrain Raisin 320g water + 521g grain = 61%.

entries.name: Gluten Free

stages.name: preheat
stages.notes: REST cycle. Length computed from REST OFF delta (2:25 - 1:52 = 33 min, manual page 13).

stages.name: knead_1
stages.notes: Duration: Add Beep timing (45 min) - REST length (33 min) = 12 min. Note: GF recipes call for the user to scrape down the pan sides at the Add Beep, not just add inclusions.

stages.name: add_ins_beep
stages.notes: Manual: Add Beep at approximately 45 min (page 13). Recipe book pages 11 instruct the user to scrape down flour from sides at this beep.

stages.name: rise_1
stages.notes: GF cycle has a markedly shorter Rise than wheat-based courses (no gluten development needed); manual chart shows compressed Rise band.

stages.name: bake
stages.notes: Bake duration estimated from chart proportions; total cycle 2:25 with 45 min Knead-end leaves 100 min for Rise + Bake split roughly 50/50.

entries.recommended_for_notes: Designed for GF flour blends (potato starch + brown rice flour + xanthan gum) with eggs and oil enrichment. Recipe book (page 11) shows Brown Rice, Italian Herb, and Raisin variants — all use Active Dry Yeast (not Rapid Rise) and require scraping down the pan at the Add Beep. hydration_range is computed using baker's-percentage water/flour (counting milk's water content); in absolute liquid terms, GF recipes carry far more added moisture than wheat-based courses.
entries.notes: Manual page 13 cycle chart: total 2:15 LIGHT / 2:25 MEDIUM / 2:35 DARK, REST OFF: 1:52, Add Beep at approx. 45 min, separate 1-hour keep-warm hold. REST OFF supported (page 12); Crust Control supported (page 18). Timer NOT supported (page 17). Recipe PDF (page 11): all 3 GF recipes use Active Dry Yeast (manual recipes for other courses use Rapid Rise). Hydration 80-110% reflects GF formulation with eggs + oil + milk + honey as combined liquid load — much higher than wheat-bread baker's-percentage hydration.

entries.name: Salt Free

stages.name: preheat
stages.notes: REST OFF NOT supported on this course (manual page 12); REST length assumed equal to Course 1 / Course 2's 31 min (cycle structure mirrors Course 1).

stages.name: knead_1
stages.notes: Duration: Add Beep timing (45 min) - assumed REST (31 min) = 14 min.

stages.name: add_ins_beep
stages.notes: Manual: Add Beep at approximately 45 min from start (page 13).

stages.name: rise_1
stages.notes: Manual chart shows two unpublished Punch Down events within Rise band; structure mirrors Course 1 Basic White.

stages.name: bake
stages.notes: Bake duration estimated from chart visual proportions; matches Course 1 White at MEDIUM crust.

entries.recommended_for_notes: Recipe book (page 12) covers Salt Free White (320g water, 545g bread flour, no salt — 59% hydration) and Salt Free Whole Wheat (400g water, 553g WW flour, vital wheat gluten — 72% hydration). Recipes substitute apple cider vinegar to compensate for lack of salt's gluten-stabilizing effect. Manual flags this course as temperature-sensitive — use chilled water above 77°F room temperature.
entries.notes: Manual page 13 cycle chart: total 3:15 LIGHT / 3:25 MEDIUM / 3:35 DARK, Add Beep at approx. 45 min, separate 1-hour keep-warm hold. REST OFF NOT supported (page 12); Crust Control supported (page 18); Timer supported per page 17 (the Whole Wheat variant in the recipe book carries TIMER OFF only because the recipe uses chilled water that may spoil under timer delay).

entries.name: Sugar Free

stages.name: preheat
stages.notes: REST OFF NOT supported on this course (manual page 12); REST length assumed equal to Courses 1/2's 31 min.

stages.name: knead_1
stages.notes: Duration: Add Beep timing (46 min) - assumed REST (31 min) = 15 min.

stages.name: add_ins_beep
stages.notes: Manual: Add Beep at approximately 46 min from start (page 13).

stages.name: rise_1
stages.notes: Sugar Free has the LONGEST rise of any course on the BB-PDC20 — yeast fermentation slows without sugar, so the cycle compensates with extra rise time. Manual chart shows the Rise band extending farther than other courses.

stages.name: bake
stages.notes: Bake duration estimated from chart proportions. Sugar Free has a slightly longer bake than Course 1 White to brown without sugar's caramelization.

entries.recommended_for_notes: The longest cycle on the BB-PDC20 (4:15) — extended rise compensates for the absence of sugar accelerating yeast fermentation. Recipe book (page 13) covers Sugar Free White (320g water, 545g bread flour — 59% hydration) and Sugar Free Whole Wheat (360g water, 553g WW flour — 65% hydration). Manual flags the course as temperature-sensitive; use chilled water above 77°F room.
entries.notes: Manual page 13 cycle chart: total 4:15 (single time — Crust Control NOT supported, no crust variants), Add Beep at approx. 46 min, separate 1-hour keep-warm hold. REST OFF NOT supported (page 12); Crust Control NOT supported (page 18); Timer supported (page 17).

entries.name: Vegan

stages.name: preheat
stages.notes: REST OFF NOT supported on this course (manual page 12); REST length assumed equal to Courses 1/2's 31 min.

stages.name: knead_1
stages.notes: Duration: Add Beep timing (45 min) - assumed REST (31 min) = 14 min.

stages.name: add_ins_beep
stages.notes: Manual: Add Beep at approximately 45 min from start (page 13).

stages.name: rise_1
stages.notes: Manual chart shows two unpublished Punch Down events within Rise band; structure mirrors Course 1 Basic White.

stages.name: bake
stages.notes: Bake duration estimated from chart proportions; matches Course 1 White at MEDIUM crust.

entries.recommended_for_notes: Recipe book (page 14) covers Vegan White (160g water + 160g almond milk, 545g bread flour, 24g olive oil — 59% hydration) and Vegan Whole Wheat (210g water + 160g almond milk, 553g WW flour with vital wheat gluten — 64% hydration). Both substitute olive oil for butter and unsweetened almond milk for dairy.
entries.notes: Manual page 13 cycle chart: total 3:15 LIGHT / 3:25 MEDIUM / 3:35 DARK, Add Beep at approx. 45 min, separate 1-hour keep-warm hold. REST OFF NOT supported (page 12); Crust Control supported (page 18); Timer NOT supported (page 17 lists VEGAN among courses where timer cannot be set, and recipe book shows TIMER OFF on both Vegan recipes — likely because almond milk is perishable under timer delay).

entries.name: Rapid White

stages.name: preheat
stages.notes: Shortened REST cycle (vs Course 1's 31 min). Length computed from REST OFF delta (2:25 - 2:07 = 18 min, manual page 13). Rapid courses minimize preheat to speed up the cycle.

stages.name: knead_1
stages.notes: Duration: Add Beep timing (35 min) - REST length (18 min) = 17 min.

stages.name: add_ins_beep
stages.notes: Manual: Add Beep at approximately 35 min from start (page 13). Earlier than Course 1's 45 min — total cycle starts earlier.

stages.name: rise_1
stages.notes: Compressed Rise band on chart; rapid cycle skips the longer second proof. Manual shows a single Punch Down event for this course (vs two for Course 1).

stages.name: bake
stages.notes: Bake duration estimated from chart proportions; same baking time as Course 1 since baking can't be 'rapid' without compromising loaf structure.

entries.recommended_for_notes: Same recipe family as Course 1 White (Rapid Basic, Rapid Italian Herb, Rapid Raisin in recipe book page 15) but completes in 2:25 instead of 3:25. Uses MORE Rapid Rise yeast (7.5g vs 6g for Course 1) to compensate for the shorter rise.
entries.notes: Manual page 13 cycle chart: total 2:15 LIGHT / 2:25 MEDIUM / 2:35 DARK, REST OFF: 2:07, Add Beep at approx. 35 min, separate 1-hour keep-warm hold. REST OFF supported (page 12); Crust Control supported (page 18); Timer NOT supported (page 17). Recipe PDF (page 15) shows 3 recipes — all use 7.5g Rapid Rise Yeast (more than Course 1's 6g) to compensate for the shorter rise.

entries.name: Rapid Whole Wheat

stages.name: preheat
stages.notes: Shortened REST cycle. Length computed from REST OFF delta (2:25 - 2:10 = 15 min, manual page 13). Even shorter than Course 9 Rapid White's 18 min REST.

stages.name: knead_1
stages.notes: Duration: Add Beep timing (37 min) - REST length (15 min) = 22 min. Longer Knead than Course 9 to develop whole-wheat gluten.

stages.name: add_ins_beep
stages.notes: Manual: Add Beep at approximately 37 min from start (page 13).

stages.name: rise_1
stages.notes: Compressed Rise band; manual shows a single Punch Down event for this course (vs two for Course 2 Whole Wheat).

stages.name: bake
stages.notes: Bake duration estimated from chart proportions; matches Course 2 Whole Wheat bake duration.

entries.recommended_for_notes: Rapid version of Course 2 Whole Wheat. Recipe book (page 16) covers Rapid 100% Whole Wheat (553g WW flour + 380g water + vital wheat gluten — 69% hydration) and Rapid Light Rye (455g bread + 87g rye + 330g water — 61% hydration).
entries.notes: Manual page 13 cycle chart: total 2:25 (single time — Crust Control NOT supported), REST OFF: 2:10, Add Beep at approx. 37 min, separate 1-hour keep-warm hold. REST OFF supported (page 12); Crust Control NOT supported (page 18); Timer NOT supported (page 17). Recipe PDF (page 16) recipes use 7.5g Rapid Rise Yeast (more than Course 2's 6g).

entries.name: Dough

stages.name: preheat
stages.notes: REST cycle. Length computed from REST OFF delta (1:50 - 1:27 = 23 min, manual page 13). Shorter than baking courses' 31 min.

stages.name: knead_1
stages.notes: Duration: Add Beep timing (38 min) - REST length (23 min) = 15 min.

stages.name: add_ins_beep
stages.notes: Manual: Add Beep at approximately 38 min from start (page 13).

stages.name: rise_1
stages.notes: Single rise; manual chart shows ONE Punch Down event (vs two for baking courses). Cycle ends after rise_1 — no bake, no keep-warm.

entries.recommended_for_notes: Knead + first rise only; the user shapes and bakes the dough externally. Recipe book pages 18-23 cover Butter Rolls, Doughnuts, Breadsticks, Bagels, and several Pizza variants — all use this course to produce shaped dough.
entries.notes: Manual page 13 cycle chart: total 1:50 (REST OFF: 1:27), Add Beep at approx. 38 min, NO bake, NO keep-warm. REST OFF supported (page 12); Crust Control NOT applicable (no bake); Timer NOT supported (page 17). Loaf sizes / crust shades empty arrays — course produces dough, not a baked loaf.

entries.name: Sourdough Starter

stages.name: preheat
stages.notes: Very short REST cycle. Length computed from REST OFF delta (2:10 - 2:05 = 5 min, manual page 13).

stages.name: knead_1
stages.notes: Duration estimated; manual chart shows no Add Beep on this course, so no anchor point exists for separating Knead from Rise. Estimate from chart visual proportions.

stages.name: rise_1
stages.notes: Long rise period for the starter culture to ferment. Manual chart shows no Punch Down events on this course.

entries.recommended_for_notes: Cultivates a sourdough starter culture (NOT a sourdough loaf — the starter is then used in a separate bake on the WHOLE WHEAT or HOMEMADE course per the operating instructions page 22). Operating instructions page 21 covers starter preparation; page 22 covers the subsequent bake. The course produces a hydrated, fermented culture rather than a baked loaf.
entries.notes: Manual page 13 cycle chart: total 2:10 (REST OFF: 2:05), NO Add Beep, NO bake, NO keep-warm, NO Punch Down. REST OFF supported (page 12); Crust Control NOT applicable; Timer NOT supported (page 17). The existing bb_pdc20_recipes.json has 'Sourdough' bread entries — those are sourdough LOAVES baked using this starter on a separate course (typically WHOLE WHEAT or HOMEMADE), not Course 12 itself.

entries.name: Cake

stages.name: knead_1
stages.notes: Mix-only stage; cakes use chemical leaveners (baking powder), not yeast — no rest, no rise. Add Beep fires at the end of mixing.

stages.name: add_ins_beep
stages.notes: Manual: Add Beep at approximately 16 min from start (page 13). Earliest Add Beep on the BB-PDC20 — fires during/at end of mixing for adding fruit/nuts to the batter.

stages.name: bake
stages.notes: Long bake — cake batter requires extended baking compared to bread dough. Duration computed as total_minutes - knead - add_beep.

entries.recommended_for_notes: Mix + bake only — designed for cake batters and quick breads using baking powder (not yeast). Recipe book (page 25) covers Pound Cake, Tea Cake, and Corn Bread. NO REST, NO RISE phase: chemical leaveners activate immediately on hydration.
entries.notes: Manual page 13 cycle chart: total 1:50, Add Beep at approx. 16 min, Bake stage, NO keep-warm. REST OFF NOT supported (page 12); Crust Control supported (page 18); Timer NOT supported (page 17). yeast_compatibility=[] because the course uses chemical leaveners; the recommendation engine should match recipes with baking_powder (not yeast).

entries.name: Jam

stages.name: preheat
stages.notes: Manual chart labels this stage 'Heat' — heater warms ingredients before stirring begins. Not a true REST in the bread sense. Duration estimated from chart visual proportions.

stages.name: knead_1
stages.notes: Manual chart labels this stage 'Heat & Mix' — heater stays on while paddle stirs the cooking jam. Modeled as knead_1 (the closest stage in our taxonomy supporting paddle action) but is functionally a heated stir, not gluten development.

entries.recommended_for_notes: Cooks fruit + sugar into jam or marmalade — heater stays on while the paddle stirs. Recipe book (page 26) covers Strawberry Jam and Orange Marmalade. NOT a bread course: produces no loaf, no crust, no rise. The 'preheat' and 'knead_1' stages model the manual's 'Heat' and 'Heat & Mix' labels respectively.
entries.notes: Manual page 13 cycle chart: total 1:20, NO Add Beep, NO Rest in bread sense, NO Rise, NO Bake, NO keep-warm. Chart labels stages 'Heat' and 'Heat & Mix' rather than the bread-cycle stages. REST OFF NOT supported (page 12); Crust Control NOT applicable; Timer NOT supported (page 17).
